summary: Tamarindo is a premier beach destination on Costa Rica's Guanacaste Peninsula, renowned for world-class surfing, pristine golden-sand beaches, and vibrant Pacific sunsets. This laid-back coastal town perfectly blends adventure activities with relaxation, offering everything from zip-lining through cloud forests to savoring fresh seafood at beachfront restaurants. Tamarindo's perfect weather, accessibility, and diverse ecosystems make it an ideal destination for both thrill-seekers and beach lovers.

activities.name: Surfing at Tamarindo Beach
activities.description: Ride consistent Pacific swells on one of Central America's most famous surf breaks, suitable for all skill levels from beginners to advanced surfers.

activities.name: Zip-lining through Cloud Forest
activities.description: Soar through the canopy on multiple zip-lines while spotting exotic wildlife and experiencing pristine rainforest ecosystems.

activities.name: Snorkeling at Las Baulas National Park
activities.description: Explore vibrant coral reefs and encounter tropical fish, sea turtles, and other marine life in crystal-clear Pacific waters.

activities.name: Sunset Catamaran Cruise
activities.description: Sail along the Guanacaste coastline at golden hour, enjoying refreshments and watching marine life while experiencing unforgettable Pacific sunsets.

activities.name: Horseback Riding in Rainforest
activities.description: Trek through lush jungle trails on horseback, crossing rivers and viewing wildlife in their natural habitat with experienced local guides.

activities.name: Visit Arenal Volcano & Hot Springs
activities.description: Day trip to Costa Rica's iconic active volcano with natural thermal pools heated by geothermal energy, featuring spectacular views and relaxation.

activities.name: Beachfront Yoga and Meditation
activities.description: Attend sunrise or sunset yoga classes on the beach with experienced instructors, combining wellness practices with oceanfront tranquility.

activities.name: Wildlife Spotting Tour
activities.description: Guided nature walk through protected reserves to observe sloths, monkeys, tropical birds, and other Costa Rican wildlife in natural habitats.

activities.name: ATV Adventure through Jungle Trails
activities.description: Experience thrilling off-road riding through rainforest terrain, crossing rivers and visiting remote beaches only accessible by ATV.

activities.name: Explore Playa Avellanas
activities.description: Beach exploration featuring tide pools, rock formations, and consistent waves, located just south of Tamarindo with excellent photography opportunities.

activities.name: Scuba Diving at Catalina Islands
activities.description: Dive among thriving coral gardens and encounter large marine species including sharks, rays, and groupers in pristine offshore waters.

activities.name: Waterfall Hike to Hacienda Pinilla
activities.description: Trek through pristine rainforest to discover multiple cascading waterfalls and natural pools perfect for swimming and scenic photography.

photography.goldenHourNotes: Tamarindo's western Pacific orientation provides exceptional sunset light for approximately 45 minutes. The wet sand and ocean surface create mirrors for reflected skies, doubling exposure possibilities. During dry season (December-April), minimal atmospheric haze ensures clarity; rainy season (May-November) offers dramatic cloud formations and moody lighting for artistic interpretations.

weather.seasonality: Tamarindo experiences distinct dry (December-April) and rainy (May-November) seasons. The dry season offers perfect beach conditions with minimal rainfall and abundant sunshine, while the rainy season brings lush landscapes, fewer tourists, and excellent deals on accommodations.
weather.summary: Tamarindo maintains warm tropical temperatures year-round (27-30°C), making it suitable for beach activities in any season. The dry season provides optimal weather for outdoor activities, while the green rainy season is ideal for budget travelers and nature enthusiasts seeking verdant landscapes and wildlife activity.
